approaches.title: Track each value's most recent index
approaches.summary: Uses a hash map from each number to its latest index, checking whether the current occurrence is within distance k before updating the stored index.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial HashMap-based solution storing the most recent index for each value.

approaches.title: Maintain a sliding window set
approaches.summary: Uses a HashSet containing the values in the previous k positions, removing the value that leaves the window before checking for a duplicate.

revisions.commitComment: set only tracks sliding window of numbers
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 219: set only tracks sliding window of numbers
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaced the index map with a sliding-window HashSet that tracks only nearby values.
